_about: Numbers of the full thesis KG build (EXP-031), read at runtime by the kg-build page (#full) and at build time by Our Data Pipeline/scripts/build_data.py. Source: vault note 'Thesis - Full KG Build' + _review/kg-full-build-plan-.md + thesis-pipeline/runs/kg-full/ (gate/scores.json, er/apply-counts.json). Frozen graph and freeze filled from data/thesis/manifests/-kg-restore.json (the final snapshot, after the PRE judge pass and the restore pass; -kg.json is superseded). pre_judge and er_ablation from the note's Log and EXP-033 sections. null = not known; the page shows 'pending'.

extraction.label: measured
extraction.extractor: Claude Opus 5.5 (subagents), one fixed prompt, 25 units per batch

rule_checks.label: measured
rule_checks.dropped_reason: an endpoint is not a mention

er.label: measured
er.judge: Claude Opus 5.5 (a first Sonnet judge decided from names alone and was rejected)
er.audit: Codex audit of 200 stratified items (LLM audit, no human): judge merges 3 of 79 wrong, rule merges 1 of 116 wrong, deletions 1 of 3 wrong; all fixed
er.band_sample: 150 random pairs in the 0.80-0.88 cosine band: 10 were the same concept (6.7%, 95% CI 3.7-11.8%)
er.band_decision: the whole 0.80-0.88 band was judged before the freeze (57 batches, 8,329 effective decisions)

gate.label: measured
gate.note: pair level, before the final merges; PREREQUISITE_OF is not gated

graph.label: measured
graph.load_rule: an edge is loaded when the extractor asserted it and either both checkers support it, or it is PREREQUISITE_OF and the prerequisite judge kept it or two blind re-judges restored it (load policy 3)

pre_judge.label: measured
pre_judge.audit_before: 11 of 50 eligible PRE edges wrong (22%, Wilson 95% CI 12.8-35.2%), LLM audit
pre_judge.restore_judges: Codex gpt-6-astra and fresh Opus 5.5 instances, blind, rubric v2 (counts teaching order)

er_ablation.label: measured
er_ablation.best_fuzzy: rapidfuzz token_set_ratio >= 88: precision 0.15, recall 0.63, F1 0.24, largest cluster 801 names
er_ablation.best_vector: bge-m3 cosine >= 0.90: precision 0.39, recall 0.44, F1 0.41, largest cluster 58 names
er_ablation.referee: Codex, blind, with passages: sides with the LLM judge in 22/25, 25/25 and 20/20 disagreement pairs (LLM audit)
